room_description: A storage pantry or break room equipped with wire shelves, a water dispenser, a red microwave over a mini-fridge, a computer desk, and wooden cabinets.

key_moments.description: Establishing shot of the storage pantry room.
Inspects the computer desk, monitors, and mouse.
Opens the red microwave to check inside.
Finds a token resting on top of the wooden cabinet.
Opens the mini-fridge to find a row of red apples inside.
Places a block of butter into the microwave and melts it.
Collects a hidden token/coin from the melted butter.
Retrieves an electric kettle from the opened cabinet drawer.
Turns on the kettle to steam a blank piece of crumpled paper.
Enters the code '572' into the combination lock inside the mini-fridge.

solution_steps: Take the frozen block of butter.
Place it inside the red microwave and turn it on to melt it away.
Place the electric kettle on the counter and turn it on.
Hold the blank piece of paper over the steam to reveal hidden ink symbols.
puzzles.reward: Clue revealing a Mask, Apple, and Rose

solution_steps: Count the corresponding items hidden around the room (Masks, Apples, Roses).
Enter the final tallied combination (572) into the 3-digit lock on the fridge drawer.

final_action: Takes the key from the fridge compartment and uses it to unlock the main door.
